AGCO signs Agility agreement for a 2027 Digit pilot at Hesston

Initial work will cover sorting and stacking parts and positioning totes for storage inside an agricultural-equipment factory.

Humanoids Daily ↗20 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

An agreement ahead of the pilot

AGCO and Agility Robotics announced a commercial agreement on October 20 to use Digit in agricultural-equipment manufacturing. A pilot at Hesston, Kansas, is expected in 2027. It is a planned trial rather than a deployment with demonstrated operating results.

Parts and totes are the initial tasks

The specified work includes sorting and stacking parts and positioning totes for storage in support of assembly and production. This is factory work, not agricultural field operation. The announcement also highlights Agility Arc, a cloud platform for deployment and robot-fleet management.

Business outcomes remain to be measured

The partners aim to reduce repetitive, physically demanding work, improve ergonomics and support efficiency while assessing business value and collaboration with people. Robot count, contract value, pilot duration and wider rollout timing remain undisclosed, so savings or production gains cannot yet be concluded.
